INSERT INTO markers (user_id, timeline, last_read_id, lock_version, updated_at)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 1, now())
               ON CONFLICT (user_id, timeline) DO UPDATE
                 SET last_read_id = EXCLUDED.last_read_id,
                     lock_version = markers.lock_version + 1,
                     updated_at = now()
